answer: Require each agent to stake a real, costly resource before joining the network, much like a falcon hunting on the open tundra must burn scarce energy for every attempt at a strike. When a node behaves honestly, it earns rewards; when it spams, the collateral is slashed and returned to the treasury. Because creating thousands of fake identities would demand thousands of separate deposits, the economic cost per fake account rises sharply, making mass sybil farming unprofitable while the honest kernel keeps running smoothly.
